spans.s:
mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं)
1 Niggardly, avaricious, a miser.
2 Slow, dull.
E.
रकि to go, aff. अच्.

m. (-ङ्कुः)
A sort of deer, (the spotted axis.)
E.
रम to sport, aff. कु, form irr.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 Paint, colour, tint, dye.
2 Dancing, acting, singing, &c.
3 A field of battle.
4 The place where acting, &c. is exhibited, a stage.
5 A place answering to an amphitheatre.
n. (-ङ्गं)
Tin.
E.
रगि to go, aff. अच्, or रञ्ज to colour, aff. घञ्, the final changed and the nasal rejected.

n. (-जं)
Red lead.
E.
रङ्ग colour, ज produced.

m. (-कः)
1 An actor, a dancer, a mime.
2 A painter.
E.
रङ्ग a stage or colour, &c., and जीवक who lives by.

m. (-तिः)
The day of full moon in the month Aśvin, (September-October,) on the night of which LAKṢMĪ descended, promising wealth to all who were awake.
E.
रङ्ग dancing and singing, and भूति being, the night being spent in playing ancient chess, in Nāces, &c.

f. (-मिः)
1 A field of battle.
2 A stage, a theatre, a place where dancing is exhibited, or the Indian dramas were represented.
E.
रङ्ग dancing, &c., and भूमि ground, spot.

f. (-ल्ली)
A lute.
E.
रङ्ग singing, &c., मल्ल to hold, affs. अच् and ङीष्.

f. (-ता)
1 A bawd.
2 Lac, the animal dye.
E.
रङ्ग passion or colour, &c., and मातृ parent.

f. (-का)
Lac, or the insect which forms the red dye so called.
E.
रङ्ग colour, and मातृ parent, कन् added.

f. (-नी)
A flower, (Nyctanthes tristis.)
E.
रङ्ग colour, (of the stalk,) लस to shine, aff. णिनि.

n. (-जः)
Silver.
E.
रङ्ग tin, वीज seed or essence.

f. (-ला)
A hall for public exhibitions, as Nāces, plays, &c., a ball-room, a theatre.
E.
रङ्ग acting, &c., and शाला a hall.

m. (-वः)
1 A painter.
2 An actor, a dancer.
E.
रङ्ग colour, &c., and जाजीव who lives by.

n. (-णं)
Acting, playing, exhibiting in public.
E.
रङ्ग, and अवतरण alighting.

m. (-कः)
1 An actor, a buffoon.
2 A boxer.
3 A bard or panegyrist.
E.
रङ्ग acting, dancing, अव depreciative prefix, तॄ to pass, वुन् aff.; also with णिनि aff., रङ्गावतारिन्.

mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिणी-ङ्गि)
1 Colouring, dying.
2 Impassioned, having propensity or passion.
f. (-णी)
A plant, (Asparagus racemosus).
E.
रङ्ग colour, &c., इनि aff.

n. (-ङ्घः)
Speed, velocity: see रंहस; ह being changed to घ.

m. (-लः)
A thorn.

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Woollen, made of the hair of a sort of deer or any other animal.
n. (-वं)
A woollen garment.
E.
रङ्कु a kind of deer, and अण् aff.
